units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:25">Targ. Job IX, 25</cite> (of a bird).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 18:23">Targ. II Sam. XVIII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:12">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="T00280"><he>רָהֲטָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="I00068"><he>טַבְלָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 51a:1">Erub. 51ᵃ</cite> top <he>והוא דכי רָהֵיט וכ׳</he> provided he may reach the root of the tree (before the Sabbath begins) by running.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:9">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מצוה למִרְהַט</he> it is right to run.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אנא נמי רְהִיטְנָא</he> I run likewise.
<cite ref="Shabbat 94a:4">Sabb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>רהיט תלתא וכ׳</he> he ran three parasangs on foot.

<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:2">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ועיזי רְהִיטָן</he> (not <cite ref="T00611"><he>ריהטן</he></cite>) the goats run, v. <cite ref="H00164"><he>חִגְּרָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 31:3">Yalk. Gen. 31</cite> <he>רְהִיטֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:7">Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>רגלייא דלא רָהֲטָן וכ׳</he> may the (my) feet that failed to run to give alms, be broken; a. fr.
